scenarios.name: Retain a hidden sketch panel after reopening the sketch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the full Sketch ribbon displays the Pattern panel
the user hides Pattern using Show Panels in the Sketch tab context menu
the user finishes the sketch without changing geometry
the user reopens the same sketch from the model browser
the Sketch ribbon is visible without the Pattern panel
the user opens Show Panels from the Sketch tab context menu
the Pattern panel returns to the Sketch ribbon
